# v1 importer golden fixtures: vault

GENERATED BY `go run ./internal/migration/golden`. DO NOT HAND EDIT.

Each `vault-<16 hex>.json` file is one record the real v1 vault importer produced from one digest-pinned input under `internal/migration/v1/testdata/v1-goldens/`, passed through the harvester's allowlist Redactor. The name is the first 16 hex digits of the sha256 of the file's canonical JSON (sorted keys, 2-space indent, LF, one trailing newline).

## Redaction policy

Before import, every entry name is renamed to a synthetic MIG_FIXTURE_SECRET name with a 1-based index and every value to a synthetic non-secret, in a scratch home whose custody is forced to the encrypted file vault under the dedicated harvest service label. Each record keeps only the importer's Changes: operation is kept, target becomes NAME-<n>, source is the input-relative path and content_hash is REDACTED.

## Regenerate

    go run ./internal/migration/golden [--domain vault] [--dry-run]

A repeat run over unchanged inputs writes nothing. To extend the input set, add the file under the pinned input dir, add its line to `INPUTS.sha256` (`<sha256>  <path>`, sorted by path), and run the harvester; it refuses any file the manifest does not list or whose digest differs.
